description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/EP2430-PPSA17461_00-0168410833925060/

Ride the sunshine together with your friends in Bus Simulator 27. With Full Crossplay and 4 player cooperative mode no one is left behind. For the first time in the history of the series, both city buses and coach buses will be available. The new coach bus journeys, including their corresponding vehicles, were recently introduced in the Coach Bus Journey Trailer.
As you build Felicia Bay’s public transport network, a wide selection of different bus types will be available to you - from classic diesel buses, CNG buses to modern electric buses and hydrogen buses. The fleet also offers plenty of variety when it comes to size: for every route, you can choose the vehicle that fits best. A shorter city bus is ideal for the narrow streets within the lively cities Mequina and Alcaztelar, while articulated or double-decker buses help you transport more passengers on busy, high-frequency routes.

#ps5 #ps5games #
title: Bus Simulator 27 - Multiplayer Trailer | PS5 Games

Crystal of Atlan x The King of Fighters '98 collab is officially live, as the popular character Mai Shiranui makes her cross-world debut in Atlan! She'll appear as a combat NPC on the battlefield, dancing through flames with her classic ninjutsu and challenging every Adventurer to a duel. Join the "Dancing With Flames" challenge battles and the "Flame Dance Pact" Check-in Event to obtain generous rewards, including collab Emoticons, collab Bauble, collab Aura, and exclusive Avatar Frame. In addition, the Fighter and Musketeer's exclusive Mai Shiranui outfit "Flaming Butterfly," chibi collab pet "Mai Shiranui," collab title "Dancing With Flames," collab Aura "Flaming Ring," collab Avatar "Mai Shiranui," and collab Avatar Frame "Crimson Firefan" will all become available at the same time. The fiery fan dance returns with a classic legend in combat—Accept her invitation and join us in an unforgettable fight
